sloka: तौ महाग्रहसङ्काशावन्योन्यं सन्निपत्य च।सङ्ग्रामे शतधा यान्तौ मेदिन्यां विनिपेततुः ।। ६.९१.५३ ।।
transliteration: tau mahāgrahasaṅkāśāvanyonyaṁ sannipatya ca।saṅgrāme śatadhā yāntau medinyāṁ vinipetatuḥ ।। 6.91.53 ।।

translations.english: By the impact of the two arrows brought together, a formidable form of fire frightening with smoke and sparks was created.
